lanes.issue: NONE (release integration maintenance; reference the release parents only in words)
lanes.title: Bring main into the release integration branch (replay runner conflict)
lanes.description: The release integration branch codex/recovered-release-free-safety-20261003 (PR #564 head, now d474317 after #572/#571/#568/#573/#574 merged) is 10 commits behind origin/main (506c9dd: the staged-proof units D0 #575, C1 #586, A2 #590, A3 #593, A1 #594, A4 #576, A7 #582 and the Jev client #591, all merged this weekend). `git merge-tree` reports ONE content conflict: scripts/ovd510-disposable-replay.mjs. On the integration branch the runner was split into a 24-line launcher plus scripts/ovd510-replay-body.mjs (1152 lines; the --ovd563 21/21 pin at :790 before the weekend's changes); main's OVD-520 proof units edited the monolithic runner (new pins such as the 23/23 STEP-review proof, the failed-attempt terminal proof, the same-run identity proof) and cite its line numbers in docs/release proofs and unit descriptions. Goal: one PR from a branch off the integration branch that merges origin/main with a merge commit, resolves the runner conflict by porting main's runner changes into the split structure (launcher unchanged, body carries the new proof steps and pins), keeps every other file's merge result, and proves both lineages still pass: the disposable replay runner with --reviewed-authority-baseline --durable-migration --ovd563 (expected the pin count from main's latest proof, e.g. 23/23 or whatever main's head asserts) and the free-quote closed profile (full139) node tests, fixture --check, migration lineage, lint, typecheck, worker verify; hosted CI green at the PR head.
lanes.guidance: Lockfiles: after the merge, compare package.json/package-lock.json/worker/* against both origin/main and the #564 branch; if they match neither, run npm ci in your worktree with TMPDIR under /dev/shm. Never rebase or force-push. Resolve ONLY the real conflict; do not hand-edit generated files (regenerate with the repo tooling). Read docs/release/*proof*.md and the OVD-520 unit descriptions on main for the runner pins they cite and update the cited line numbers in the docs if the body file's layout moves them (docs are documentation; keep the proof semantics). Run ensure-docker.sh; DB work under /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock; the replay runner is heavy (one run, under the lock). Never write the release-parent identifiers listed in ENV.md in the branch name, commits, PR title or body; describe them in words. Open a DRAFT PR with base codex/recovered-release-free-safety-20261003.
lanes.failure_first: Before the merge, on the integration branch tip, the replay runner proof pins from main are absent (record the runner's current pin assertion and the proof files' expectations). After the merge, both the runner proof and the full139 profile pass. Mutation: revert one ported proof step in the body on a scratch copy and show the runner reports the failing pin.
lanes.verification: node --test scripts/free-quote-ci-profile.node-test.mjs scripts/free-quote-psql-races.node-test.mjs; node scripts/generate-free-quote-fixtures.mjs --check; npm run verify:migration-lineage; flock /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock node scripts/ovd510-disposable-replay.mjs --reviewed-authority-baseline --durable-migration --ovd563 (record the pin result); npx vitest run on the test files main's merged units added (the staged-proof CI tests); npm run lint && npm run typecheck; npm --prefix worker run verify. Hosted (authoritative): ci, test, free-quote-sql, ovd591 jobs, browser-test, verify-worker, Sonar at the PR head.
